How to import an MDR into EngiCite
Open the MDR Import sheet and enter one planned deliverable per row.
Do not rename the required headings or add formulas to import cells.
Discipline and Document Type must match an active EngiCite category name or short code.
Use real Excel dates or YYYY-MM-DD. Planned Final Date cannot precede the submission date.
Progress Weight is optional and defaults to 1. Valid values are greater than 0 and no more than 1000.
Save as .xlsx, upload it in the MDR, review the preview, then confirm import.
